verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS work-management platform, but the evidence pack never documents retention policies, deletion controls, or data-lifecycle settings. The closest item, agent governance over data access and audit trails (asana-docs-13), is an adjacent access control, not retention or deletion, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
